body.x: DREMEL (www.dremel.com), a maker of versatile tool systems that deliver the perfect solution for almost any job, unveiled "3D Idea Builder" at CES 2015, which runed Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.It is easy to build objects with the Dremel on-board software and color touchscreen, which enables a preview of each model before building models. Additionally, unlike other 3D printers that require users to install it, the Dremel 3D Idea Builder comes equipped with a pre-installed extruder, so it makes setup as simple as plugging in printer. Along with easy-to-use software, users can start turning their ideas into models and projects in minutes.The Idea Builder features a closable door that keeps out dust and prying fingers. This fully enclosed workspace also stabilizes the temperature for an optimal build, and reduces noise.UL Certified, the Dremel 3D Idea Builder is fully operational without a computer. With the full color touchscreen, users can select models to build, and can control the print process with Start, Stop, and Pause buttons… and much more. The touchscreen even displays helpful information and the printing status of the model.
